PRODUCT_NAME: Microflex Ultraform UF-524 Powder Free Thin Nitrile Exam Gloves, 9.1 in., Cobalt Blue, S
DESCRIPTION:
MICROFLEX® Ultraform® are thin nitrile gloves that reliably protect hands while offering exceptional tactility for jobs requiring fine motor control. Designed with ERGOFORM Ergonomic Design Technology, these thin, tactile gloves are proven to reduce the amount of muscle effort wearers exert while performing repetitive tasks when compared to similar disposable nitrile gloves†. This is important, as OSHA states that performing repetitive tasks can lead to musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) and injury. The soft nitrile of MICROFLEX Ultraform exam gloves comfortably forms to hands, for a superior fit and feel during extended wear.

Compliant with US Food Contact regulations, MICROFLEX Ultraform are a great choice to protect the hands of food workers. Because these thin nitrile gloves are medical grade, they can be used by healthcare and dental professionals when treating patients. Their thin design and chemical splash resistance make MICROFLEX Ultraform a good option for lab researchers handling delicate glassware, equipment and instruments. Smartly packed with 300 gloves per dispenser box, these lightweight, tactile gloves save money and reduce waste††.

• Collapse resistant cup shape design

Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe.

Cleaning & Sanitation Drum Lock Safety Clamp with Black Chemical filter; used solely for applications where a 3/8" solid drum probe is used for feeding chemicals;. Chemically resistant to high-strength acids and bases, this is our most application-specific model. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in 7 colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. This Clamp is used when you want to store a chemical drum that has been opened and the opening needs to be closed or re-sealed.

  • Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.
  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Allows you to close off an open chemical drum bung and reduce vapors and harmful gasses from escaping
  • Includes an enhanced, cross-linked, closed-cell, high-density copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications using a 3/8" drum probe
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved

PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe.

Cleaning & Sanitation Drum Lock Safety Clamp with Black Chemical filter; used solely for applications where a 3/8" solid drum probe is used for feeding chemicals;. Chemically resistant to high-strength acids and bases, this is our most application-specific model. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in 7 colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. This Clamp is used when you want to store a chemical drum that has been opened and the opening needs to be closed or re-sealed.

  • Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.
  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Allows you to close off an open chemical drum bung and reduce vapors and harmful gasses from escaping
  • Includes an enhanced, cross-linked, closed-cell, high-density copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications using a 3/8" drum probe
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Density rating: LD45
Default hole size: 16mm

  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

PRODUCT_NAME: Epic Microporous High Performance Coveralls, Elastic Wrists and Ankles, Zipper Front, White, 5XL
DESCRIPTION:
Latex free / lint free film coated coverall for use in critical and low particulate clean environments. Fabric is suitable for exposure to bloodborne pathogens, some hazardous liquids, and where liquid splash is a concern. Features include a zipper front entry, elastic wrists, elastic ankles, elastic lower back, and a storm flap zipper cover, serged seam construction. Fabric is constructed from a blend of polyethylene and polypropylene into a unique breathable membrane. The finished fabric also contains anti-static properties from a proprietary additive. Individually inspected for sizing, stitching and workmanship.

• ISO Cleanroom Class: 6 / Helmke Drum Testing IEST-RP-CC003.3
• Material Weight: 60gm/m2
• Color: White
• Packaging: Neatly folded and packed 25 pieces per case in a sealed inner poly-bag

• Static Dissipative: <1011 surface resistance
• Grab Strength: MD: 20.3 lbs, XD: 14.5 lbs (ASTM D751)
• Ball Burst: 20.3 lbs (ASTM D3787)

• Water Resistance: 60 (ASTM D751)
• Breathability: 3318 g/m2, 90F & 50%RH (ASTM E96)
• Flammability: Class 1 (CPSC 1610)
• Bloodborne Pathogens: Fabric only / PASS (ASTM F1671)
• Meets CE Protective Requirement - Type 5 (EN ISO 13982-1)

Meets the requirements for NFPA 1999 Standard on Protective Clothing for Emergency Medical Operations, 2013 edition.

• Chlorinated
• Textured fingertips
• Beaded cuff

The amazing elasticity of these nitrile gloves help to reduce hand fatigue and stress by forming to your hand to allow full range of motion. High quality nitrile provides extra protection over the wrist and forearm for a reliable barrier protection against many hazardous and infectious substances. Textured fingertips and a unique finishing process delivers an outstanding grip for both small utensils and large instruments in wet and dry environments. Polymer coated for quick and easy donning. PRODUCT_NAME: KIMTECH G5 Powder-Free Co-Polymer Cleanroom Gloves, 12 in, L
DESCRIPTION:

KIMTECH™ G5 Co-Polymer Gloves are recommended for ISO Class 5 or higher cleanroom environments (double bagged with case liner).

Precise Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment for work with contamination-sensitive materials. Procedures where low levels of oxygen or moisture are important, such as work with organometallics, alternative energy cells or hydrophilic chemicals, are typical applications for these economical glove boxes. Need an ultrapure inert atmosphere All Precise Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) and 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).

Features:
• One-piece molded, medium-density polyethylene shell
• Dry powder epoxy-coated steel superstructure
• 1/4 in. thick laminated safety glass viewing window, 26.4 in. wide x 12.5 in. high, removable for loading equipment, with powder-coated steel frame and neoprene gasket
• Space-saving inner and outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, are counterbalanced and equipped with quick-latches
• Black, chemical-resistant work surface sealed to the glove box floor
• Pressure relief valve that activates at pressure/vacuum above 6 inches or below -6 inches of water gauge.
• Pressure relief valve vent, 4 in. nominal diameter
• Interior ceiling-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 5 amp maximum circuit load
• Neoprene gloves, size 9 3/4, are included.
• Fluorescent lamp, 22 watts, with easy replacement from the top
• Switches for light and innermost interior electrical receptacle
• Approximately 13 cubic feet of interior space in main chamber
• 11.0 in. nominal ID x 12.0 in. long transfer chamber
• Factory leak tested with a mass spectrometer while glove box is pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge.
• No detectable leaks greater than 1 x 10(-4) ml/sec
• Meet Class 1 atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen leak rates per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Six manual valves for purging and filling of both main chamber and transfer chamber and for drying train connections
• Main chamber pressure gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure gauge with readings from 0 to -29 inches of mercury
• Transfer chamber high vacuum sleeve and interior interlocking shelf of dry powder epoxy-coated steel
• ETL listed

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Humidifier Filter, CApture BT
PRODUCT_NAME: Humidifier Filter, CApture BT
DESCRIPTION:
The CApture™ BT is a spacious benchtop Cyanoacrylate (CA) evidence fuming chamber with a durable, easy-to-clean stainless steel liner. Its ample interior with shelving system maximizes fuming capacity and accommodates large evidence including long guns.

The microprocessor-controlled operating system allows for adjustment of chamber humidity to 80% +/- 5% relative humidity, pre-fuming humidity incubation, fuming temperature up to 424 DEG F within +/- 1%, and fuming and exhaust times. System stores 20 programs, has 3 factory set programs (Low, High, Lumincyano) and includes diagnostic mode with audible/visual alerts for program cycle completion. Acti-Vent™ Smart Controls purge air during critical steps to protect evidence from over fuming exposure and the user from fumes.

The CApture BT is constructed of a powder-coated steel exterior, type 304 brushed stainless steel interior with removable perforated floor, four stainless steel hanging rods (26.9 in. long x 3/8 in. dia.) and quick-release sidewall brackets mounted at four heights. A storage drawer with flush-mounted handle is located beneath the chamber.

It includes a built-in humidifier, full-color eye-level LCD control screen, recirculation blower, exhaust blower, and interior LED light. The tempered safety glass door has an electronic door lock to prevent opening during the fuming cycle and includes a power outage override. Filters are accessible from inside the chamber for easy replacement.

Four leveling feet, 10 ft. power cord and plug, one Prefilter, one Carbon Filter, and one Humidifier Filter are included with each CApture BT Fuming Chamber. Optional accessories include mobile base stand, shelves, casing and long gun holders, hanging rods, clips, and security tags(each sold separately).

Super Glue, fuming dishes, and purified water are required (not included).

ETL and ETL-C listed. CE conformity marking.

PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1118 + Filter CFS-0316, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1118 + Filter CFS-0316, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit, Choose Filter & Collar color. Note: Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

This Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit gets you everything you need to safely feed chemicals in and out of drums while minimizing fumes and complying with FDA regulations. Kit Includes the following:

  • (1) Drum Feed Safety Clamp (choose model)
  • (1) Replacement filter (same model)
  • (1) Spare EPDM plug fitting CFS-1013
  • (1) Spare Silicone plug fitting CFS-1012
  • (10) Drum Seal Tags # CFS-1014 (lock-out tag-out serialized ID safety tags)

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Choose your preferred style: Standard White Chemical Filter (most popular model # CFS-1117), Specialized Application: Sanitary 3/8" Feed Tube Black Chemical Filter (CFS-1118), Tear-Out-Center Black Chemical Filter for larger tubing sizes (CFS-1119), or Solid Filter for inactive Lock-Out, Tag-Out drums (CFS-1120).

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1120 + Filter CFS-0318, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags, Black
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1120 + Filter CFS-0318, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1120 + Filter CFS-0318, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit, Choose Filter & Collar color. Note: Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

This Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit gets you everything you need to safely feed chemicals in and out of drums while minimizing fumes and complying with FDA regulations. Kit Includes the following:

  • (1) Drum Feed Safety Clamp (choose model)
  • (1) Replacement filter (same model)
  • (1) Spare EPDM plug fitting CFS-1013
  • (1) Spare Silicone plug fitting CFS-1012
  • (10) Drum Seal Tags # CFS-1014 (lock-out tag-out serialized ID safety tags)

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Choose your preferred style: Standard White Chemical Filter (most popular model # CFS-1117), Specialized Application: Sanitary 3/8" Feed Tube Black Chemical Filter (CFS-1118), Tear-Out-Center Black Chemical Filter for larger tubing sizes (CFS-1119), or Solid Filter for inactive Lock-Out, Tag-Out drums (CFS-1120).

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Clamps can be applied or removed at any time during fluid feed operation*
  • Use in conjunction with the Chemical Drum Seal # CFS-1014 for compliance with the FDA's FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding chemical product*. Ideal for Lock-Out, Tag-Out (LOTO) of a chemical drum, while off-line.
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug # CFS-1013 and 1 Silicone plug # CFS-1012 for extreme chemicals such as Chloroform, Bromine, and Carbon Tetrachloride,

*except the Solid Filter, which cannot be used during an operation because it cannot have tubing put through it. Solid filter is for use while drum is inactive.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality

  • Mining
  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1117 + Filter CFS-0315, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags, Yellow
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1117 + Filter CFS-0315, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1117 + Filter CFS-0315, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit, Choose Filter & Collar color. Note: Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

This Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit gets you everything you need to safely feed chemicals in and out of drums while minimizing fumes and complying with FDA regulations. Kit Includes the following:

  • (1) Drum Feed Safety Clamp (choose model)
  • (1) Replacement filter (same model)
  • (1) Spare EPDM plug fitting CFS-1013
  • (1) Spare Silicone plug fitting CFS-1012
  • (10) Drum Seal Tags # CFS-1014 (lock-out tag-out serialized ID safety tags)

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Choose your preferred style: Standard White Chemical Filter (most popular model # CFS-1117), Specialized Application: Sanitary 3/8" Feed Tube Black Chemical Filter (CFS-1118), Tear-Out-Center Black Chemical Filter for larger tubing sizes (CFS-1119), or Solid Filter for inactive Lock-Out, Tag-Out drums (CFS-1120).

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Clamps can be applied or removed at any time during fluid feed operation*
  • Use in conjunction with the Chemical Drum Seal # CFS-1014 for compliance with the FDA's FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding chemical product*. Ideal for Lock-Out, Tag-Out (LOTO) of a chemical drum, while off-line.
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug # CFS-1013 and 1 Silicone plug # CFS-1012 for extreme chemicals such as Chloroform, Bromine, and Carbon Tetrachloride,

*except the Solid Filter, which cannot be used during an operation because it cannot have tubing put through it. Solid filter is for use while drum is inactive.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality
  • Pharmaceuticals
  • Chemical Processing
  • Power Generation / Utilities
  • Refining
  • Mining
  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing
  • Semi-Conductor
  • Pulp & Paper
  • Health Care
  • Laundry
  • Design & Build Engineering Services
  • Contract Manufacturing

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size, Yellow
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp, Enhanced All-In-One Flexible Hole Size. Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Filter fits all sizes of feed hoses, tubes, etc. and is the most versatile drum lock in terms of tubing size (fits up to 1.2" tubing with all inner rings removed.) Custom-fit filter allows the end user to tear away various center sections until the opening fits their feed tube apparatus
  • Includes cross-linked, closed-cell, copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Memory properties allow the enhanced filter to close around the feed tube or probe and retain perfect shape for the next drum change-out
  • Includes 1 black EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.


All-in-One Filter with Tear-Out Center Rings: Our most flexible all-in-one design allows you to choose from 4 hole sizes in one filter. Ideal for large tubing or for companies that regularly switch between different tubing sizes; keep one filter on hand for your 3/8" feed tubing and another for your 1" hose. Multiple perforations allow for a snug seal around these industry standard sizes: 3/8" (OD) tubing, a 3/8" drum probe, a 1/2" drum probe, or a 1" flex hose.
Density rating: LD33
Hole size (depending on how many inner rings you remove): 8mm, 16mm, 22mm or 30mm

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality
  • Pharmaceuticals
  • Chemical Processing
  • Power Generation / Utilities
  • Refining
  • Mining
  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing
  • Semi-Conductor
  • Pulp & Paper
  • Health Care
  • Laundry
  • Design & Build Engineering Services
  • Contract Manufacturing

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe, White
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe.

Cleaning & Sanitation Drum Lock Safety Clamp with Black Chemical filter; used solely for applications where a 3/8" solid drum probe is used for feeding chemicals;. Chemically resistant to high-strength acids and bases, this is our most application-specific model. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in 7 colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. This Clamp is used when you want to store a chemical drum that has been opened and the opening needs to be closed or re-sealed.

  • Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.
  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Allows you to close off an open chemical drum bung and reduce vapors and harmful gasses from escaping
  • Includes an enhanced, cross-linked, closed-cell, high-density copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications using a 3/8" drum probe
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Density rating: LD45
Default hole size: 16mm

  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality

  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Microporous Coated Cleanroom Frock, Knit Wrists and Collar, Snap Front, No Pockets, S
PRODUCT_NAME: Microporous Coated Cleanroom Frock, Knit Wrists and Collar, Snap Front, No Pockets, S
DESCRIPTION:
Lint free film coated frock for use in critical, ESD and low particulate clean environments. Suitable for exposure to bloodborne pathogens, some hazardous liquids, and any wet general maintenance areas. Features include a snap front, knit wrists and knit collar. No pockets. Fabric is constructed from a blend of polyethylene and polypropylene into a unique breathable membrane. The finished fabric contains a proprietary additive making it static dissipative. Individually inspected for sizing, stitching and workmanship.

Specifications:
• ISO Cleanroom Class: 6 per Helmke Drum Testing IEST-RP-CC003.3
• Material Weight: 60 gm/m2
• Color: White garment with white snaps, white knit wrists and white knit collar.
• Packaging: Neatly folded and cleanroom packed - 10 pieces per sealed inner polybag, 3 polybags per sealed master bag, 30 pieces per case

Test Results:
• Static Dissipative: <1011 surface resistance
• Grab Strength: MD: 20.3 lbs, XD: 14.5 lbs ASTM D751
• Ball Burst: 20.3 lbs ASTM D3787
• Puncture/Tear: MD: 4.9 lbs, XD: 5.8 lbs ASTM D2582
• Water Resistance: 60 ASTM D751
• Breathability: 3318 g/m2, 90F & 50%RH ASTM E96
• Flammability: Class 1 CPSC 1610
• Bloodborne Pathogens: Fabric only / PASS ASTM F1671

PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp, Enhanced All-In-One Flexible Hole Size. Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Filter fits all sizes of feed hoses, tubes, etc. and is the most versatile drum lock in terms of tubing size (fits up to 1.2" tubing with all inner rings removed.) Custom-fit filter allows the end user to tear away various center sections until the opening fits their feed tube apparatus
  • Includes cross-linked, closed-cell, copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Memory properties allow the enhanced filter to close around the feed tube or probe and retain perfect shape for the next drum change-out
  • Includes 1 black EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.


All-in-One Filter with Tear-Out Center Rings: Our most flexible all-in-one design allows you to choose from 4 hole sizes in one filter. Ideal for large tubing or for companies that regularly switch between different tubing sizes; keep one filter on hand for your 3/8" feed tubing and another for your 1" hose. Multiple perforations allow for a snug seal around these industry standard sizes: 3/8" (OD) tubing, a 3/8" drum probe, a 1/2" drum probe, or a 1" flex hose.
Density rating: LD33
Hole size (depending on how many inner rings you remove): 8mm, 16mm, 22mm or 30mm

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy

DESCRIPTION:

DESCRIPTION: These heavy-duty, chemical-resistant aprons are made of PVC and designed to protect against acids, alcohol, oils, grease, fats, and a variety of chemicals. Our PVC aprons are liquid-resistant, abrasion-resistant, and puncture-resistant to withstand tough work environments. Aprons also protect against liquid splash, sprays, and non-hazardous dry particulates. Each apron has a loop to go over the head and nylon ties on the back. All edges are ultrasonically welded to reduce linting and the release of unwanted particulates into the cleanroom environment. Aprons offer full protection of the front of the body from the chest to the knees or below. These PVC-coated aprons have long sleeves with tunnelized elastic cuffs to protect the arms from splashes and sprays and to also increase particle containment. These chemically coated aprons are versatile with possible applications including semi-conductor, cleanroom, pharmaceutical, chemical processing, petrochemicals, sanitation work, and more.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe, Orange
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Fixed Size Filter for 3/8" Drum Probe.

Cleaning & Sanitation Drum Lock Safety Clamp with Black Chemical filter; used solely for applications where a 3/8" solid drum probe is used for feeding chemicals;. Chemically resistant to high-strength acids and bases, this is our most application-specific model. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in 7 colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. This Clamp is used when you want to store a chemical drum that has been opened and the opening needs to be closed or re-sealed.

  • Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.
  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Allows you to close off an open chemical drum bung and reduce vapors and harmful gasses from escaping
  • Includes an enhanced, cross-linked, closed-cell, high-density copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications using a 3/8" drum probe
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Density rating: LD45
Default hole size: 16mm

  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional

In addition to hiding stains, the dark color of these sturdy gloves makes it easy for workers to see lighter materials they handle. MidKnight gloves from MICROFLEX are medical examination grade, and compliant with U.S. Food Contact regulations.

DESCRIPTION:
DuPont™ Tyvek® Disposable Coveralls are made from a unique, non-woven material which is created by flash spun high-density polyethylene provides an inherent barrier to small size particles. Durable fabric delivers consistently better barrier, even after wear and abrasion. It features attached Tyvek® FC boots with a special coating to render added skid-resistance and an elastic opening for tighter fit at wrist. Coverall comes with an attached respirator-fit hood having elastic around face opening designed to cover neck as well as chin and fit around respirator face mask. Coverall with a comfort fit design enables a greater range of movement while stretching and bending. It offers a more tailored fit with reinforcement in high stress areas for fewer blowouts. Coverall has a longer zipper which extends to chin for complete coverage of neck area and for easier donning as well as doffing. Lightweight, low-linting and anti-static coverall offers enhanced mobility with more room throughout the back.

• Excellent abrasion resistance stops particles down to one micron
• Attached respirator-fit hood with elastic around face opening, designed to cover neck and chin and fit around respirator face mask
• Longer zipper extends to chin for complete coverage of neck area

DESCRIPTION: Tyvek® 400 garments are composed of flash spun high density polyethylene which creates a unique, nonwoven material available only from DuPont. Tyvek® 400 provides an ideal balance of protection, durability and comfort of any limited use fabric technology. Tyvek® 400 fabric offers an inherent barrier against particles (down to 1.0 micron in size). Protection is built into the fabric itself; there are no films or laminates to abrade or wear away. Tyvek® 400 fabric's durability advantage over microporous film fabrics delivers consistently better barrier, even after wear and abrasion. Applications include: lead and asbestos abatement/remediation, general maintenance/operations, spray painting, general clean-up. PRODUCT_NAME: 3M Regular Particulate Respirator Mask Cone Molded, 20/bx (Continental US+HI Only) (Orders are Non-Cancellable and Non-Returnable)
DESCRIPTION:
The 3M health care particulate respirator and surgical mask helps provide respiratory protection against certain airborne biological particles. It is disposable and fluid resistant to splash and spatter of blood and other infectious material.

This healthcare respirator is designed to help provide respiratory protection for the wearer. It meets CDC guidelines for Mycobacterium tuberculosis exposure control. As a disposable particulate respirator, it is intended to help reduce wearer exposure to certain airborne particles including those generated by electrocautery, laser surgery, and other powered medical instruments. As a surgical mask, it is designed to be fluid resistant to splash and spatter of blood and other infectious materials.

Features:
• NIOSH approved N95
• Meets CDC guidelines for Mycobacterium tuberculosis exposure control
• FDA cleared for use as a surgical mask
• 99% BFE (Bacterial Filtration Efficiency) according to ASTM F2101
• Fluid resistant according to ASTM F1862
• Respirator contains no components made from natural rubber latex
• Collapse resistant cup shape design
• Braided headbands, cushioning nose foam, and light weight construction for comfortable wear

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size, Black
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Choose-Your-Own Hole Size.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp, Enhanced All-In-One Flexible Hole Size. Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Filter fits all sizes of feed hoses, tubes, etc. and is the most versatile drum lock in terms of tubing size (fits up to 1.2" tubing with all inner rings removed.) Custom-fit filter allows the end user to tear away various center sections until the opening fits their feed tube apparatus
  • Includes cross-linked, closed-cell, copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Memory properties allow the enhanced filter to close around the feed tube or probe and retain perfect shape for the next drum change-out
  • Includes 1 black EPDM tapered plug
  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Chemical Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.


All-in-One Filter with Tear-Out Center Rings: Our most flexible all-in-one design allows you to choose from 4 hole sizes in one filter. Ideal for large tubing or for companies that regularly switch between different tubing sizes; keep one filter on hand for your 3/8" feed tubing and another for your 1" hose. Multiple perforations allow for a snug seal around these industry standard sizes: 3/8" (OD) tubing, a 3/8" drum probe, a 1/2" drum probe, or a 1" flex hose.
Density rating: LD33
Hole size (depending on how many inner rings you remove): 8mm, 16mm, 22mm or 30mm

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1118 + Filter CFS-0316, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags, Green
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1118 + Filter CFS-0316, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Starter Kit, CFS-1118 + Filter CFS-0316, 2 plugs, 10 LOTO tags.

Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit, Choose Filter & Collar color. Note: Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

This Drum Lock Safety Clamp Starter Kit gets you everything you need to safely feed chemicals in and out of drums while minimizing fumes and complying with FDA regulations. Kit Includes the following:

  • (1) Drum Feed Safety Clamp (choose model)
  • (1) Replacement filter (same model)
  • (1) Spare EPDM plug fitting CFS-1013
  • (1) Spare Silicone plug fitting CFS-1012
  • (10) Drum Seal Tags # CFS-1014 (lock-out tag-out serialized ID safety tags)

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Outer drum-lock clamp housing is made of polypropylene and is available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Choose your preferred style: Standard White Chemical Filter (most popular model # CFS-1117), Specialized Application: Sanitary 3/8" Feed Tube Black Chemical Filter (CFS-1118), Tear-Out-Center Black Chemical Filter for larger tubing sizes (CFS-1119), or Solid Filter for inactive Lock-Out, Tag-Out drums (CFS-1120).

Features:

  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Clamps can be applied or removed at any time during fluid feed operation*
  • Use in conjunction with the Chemical Drum Seal # CFS-1014 for compliance with the FDA's FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding chemical product*. Ideal for Lock-Out, Tag-Out (LOTO) of a chemical drum, while off-line.
  • Includes 1 EPDM tapered plug # CFS-1013 and 1 Silicone plug # CFS-1012 for extreme chemicals such as Chloroform, Bromine, and Carbon Tetrachloride,

*except the Solid Filter, which cannot be used during an operation because it cannot have tubing put through it. Solid filter is for use while drum is inactive.

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality

  • Chemical Processing

  • Refining
  • Mining
  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing

Transforming Technologies GK1000 Table Mat Ground Kit offers the hardware required by ANSI/ESD S-6.1 and ANSI/ESD-S20.20 to ground an ESD table mat The CP2522 is a low profile common point ground with two banana jacks which allow two workers the ability to plug into onto one ground point.
